name: Fahimtran
description: Inspired by Roo Code, has a suite of agents (and eventually skills) that aim to reduce context bloat and speed up task execution.
longDescription:
Ships **14 agents**.

- **Agents** (14): `architect` (Technical leader and system designer for planning architecture, evaluating trade-offs, and creating implementation plans), `ask` (Knowledgeable technical assistant for answering questions about the codebase, explaining concepts, and providing guidance — without making any…), `code-reviewer` (Proactive code reviewer that catches bugs, security issues, and style violations in recent changes), `code` (Skilled software engineer for writing, editing, and refactoring code), `db` (Database specialist for writing and reviewing migrations, queries, schema design, and ORM code), `debug` (Expert diagnostician for systematic troubleshooting, bug investigation, and issue resolution), `devops` (DevOps and infrastructure specialist for Dockerfiles, CI/CD pipelines, deployment configs, and infrastructure-as-code), `docs` (Documentation writer that generates and updates READMEs, API docs, inline comments, and changelogs), and 6 more

Installs with `claude plugin install fahimtran@claude-community` from `fahimtran/claude-plugins`.
